title: Director of Performance Marketing, Calendar
description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter). Our latest product is Calendar 2, which just launched to rave reviews.

Skylight ’s mission is to build the OS of the family. We make consumer products, like Skylight Frame and Skylight Calendar, that are loved by millions of people across the globe. Through a singular focus on care for our customers, Skylight has scaled from a school project to over $300M in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped. We have a huge opportunity to make family life easier and more connected, and that’s why we have been working hard to expand our team.
We’re looking for a Director of Performance Marketing to own the core digital acquisition channels for Skylight Calendar. You’ll manage an eight-figure budget across channels like Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin. You’ll decide where the next dollar goes and build the testing and measurement program that tells us what’s really working. You’ll report to our Director of Growth and work closely with our creative, offline, influencer, ecommerce, brand, and retail teams. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who thinks in marginal dollars and maximizing ROI and is as comfortable in an ad account as in a contribution model.
What you’ll own

• Channel performance and budget

• Optimize spend across digital channels continuously, maximizing growth while hitting blended and channel-level CAC and contribution targets

• Build monthly, quarterly and promotional spend plans (holiday, Mother’s Day, new launches) tied to revenue, inventory and margin goals

• Design campaign structure for algorithmic performance; oversee optimization strategy and manage small teams to execute channel plans. Step in to support with hands on keys adjustments as needed.

• Test new channels and tactics with clear hypotheses, success criteria and thresholds for scaling

• Incrementality and measurement

• Own the roadmap for digital incrementality testing (geo-holdouts, lift studies) to guide channel mix decisions, validate spend and open up new tactics

• Reconcile platform reporting with incrementality, MMM and post-purchase survey data, and define which signals drive decisions

• Understand halo effects: how digital spend drives sales at retail and on Amazon, not just DTC

• Work with ecommerce to test funnels and optimize conversion rate.

• Creative and testing

• Work with the creative team, creative strategist, brand, and product marketing to set creative priorities and resourcing

• Oversee a high-velocity creative testing program; support the Digital Performance Manager in balancing tradeoffs (velocity vs. quality)

• Collaborate with marketing channel leads on testing roadmaps, including new audiences, messaging angles and offers

• Leadership and communication

• Lead and develop media buyers and analysts, and manage agency and platform partners

• Explain performance clearly to leadership: what changed, why, and what we’ll do next

Requirements

• 8+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a growth leadership role at a consumer brand

• Strong paid social and paid search competency at scale. Has managed an eight-figure annual budget across Meta, Google and at least one other channel, allocating spend based on marginal returns

• Has designed and run incrementality tests and used MMM or causal measurement to make spend decisions.

• Deep fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, contribution margin, payback and LTV

• Strong creative instincts, with the ability to turn performance data into briefs that produce winning ads

• Strong technical understanding of signal infrastructure (e.g. pixels, Conversions API, server-side tracking and first-party data)

• Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or BI tools like Omni or Looker are a plus)

title: Solutions Consultant Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output-new logo, expansion, and renewals-and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals-and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new-this is the role.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

- Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes-accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

- Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

- Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

- Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion-driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

- Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

- Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy-owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

- Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

- Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales-you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

- Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

- Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change-not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

- Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

- You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

Fanatics Collect  |  Global Operations  |  Reports to : SVP, Operations

Location : Portland area (Tualatin, OR)  |  Full-time, on-site

 

About the Role

Fanatics Collect is building the most trusted marketplace for collectibles, and the Vault is the foundation of that trust. As volume grows, the Vault has to scale on engineered systems rather than headcount: robotics, automation, software and data that keep high-value assets secure, accurately tracked and moving fast.

The Vice President, Operations Engineering & Automation owns that engine. You will design, build and deploy the automation, systems and engineering capabilities that power Vault operations, and help turn the Portland-area site into a flagship, AI-enabled facility. You will work in lockstep with the Vault Facility and Vault Performance teams who run daily operations, and with Marketplace Operations, whose growth plans and new programs your platforms must support.

This is a hands-on senior leadership role for someone who has put automation on a real warehouse or fulfillment floor, and who can make the business case, deliver the project and hand it off to the operators who run it.

 

What You Will Do

Strategy & Roadmap

• Set the automation roadmap. Define and sequence the multi-year operations engineering and automation strategy, covering robotics, material handling, process automation and AI-enabled workflows, tied to volume forecasts and the Vault growth plan.

• Build the business case. Size each investment, set ROI and payback targets, and manage capital plans so fixed investments leverage into lower unit cost and higher throughput as volume scales.

• Design for scale. Define the target operating model and site architecture for the Portland-area site and future Vault sites, including layout, flow, capacity and expansion readiness.

Engineering & Delivery

• Lead Operations Engineering. Own industrial, process, controls and systems engineering for receiving, intake and authentication, storage, inventory control, fulfillment and outbound shipping.

• Deploy automation. Select, integrate and commission robotics, conveyance, storage and retrieval, scanning and imaging, and other automation, from vendor selection through launch and stabilization.

• Integrate the systems layer. Partner with Technology and Product to connect WMS, inventory control, order management and operational data so automation, chain of custody and reporting work as one system.

• Apply AI to operations. Identify and deliver AI-driven workflows that improve accuracy, cycle time, exception handling and decision-making on the floor.

• Standardize and hand off. Define SOPs

About the role: What's in the Box

Are you passionate about turning operational challenges into practical technical solutions? Do you enjoy working across different locations, bringing people together and taking projects from initial concept through to on-site implementation?

As Senior Warehouse Design Manager (all genders), you will play a key role in improving and developing the infrastructure and processes across our European Fulfilment Centre network. Rather than focusing on large-scale factory launches, you will lead targeted engineering and operational improvement projects, translating business needs into practical solutions that make our operations more efficient, scalable and reliable.

Working closely with local Operations teams, Finance, Procurement, external suppliers and our Automation specialists, you will take ownership of projects from initial assessment and solution design through procurement, coordination and on-site implementation.

This is an international, hands-on role with a strong operational focus. You will regularly travel to our Fulfilment Centres across Europe, including locations in Germany, the Netherlands and the Nordics, to understand local challenges, coordinate implementation activities and ensure that solutions work in practice.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Lead engineering and improvement projects: Own targeted projects from initial scoping and requirements gathering through solution development, implementation and handover to local operations.

• Design practical solutions: Develop and evaluate concepts for material flow, warehouse layouts, equipment and operational infrastructure, ensuring solutions meet local business needs.

• Drive procurement and implementation: Coordinate direct and indirect procurement activities, including CAPEX projects, in close collaboration with local Finance teams, Procurement and our Amsterdam-based colleagues.

• Make things happen on-site: Coordinate suppliers, contractors and local stakeholders to manage equipment delivery, installation, commissioning and implementation at our Fulfilment Centres.

• Collaborate across functions: Work closely with Operations, Automation, IT Infrastructure, Tech, FSQA and Health & Safety to ensure smooth project execution.

• Improve existing operations: Identify opportunities to optimize existing processes, equipment and material flows, translating operational challenges into tangible improvements.

• Manage project delivery: Define timelines, milestones and deliverables, manage dependencies and proactively address risks and resource constraints.

• Connect our international network: Build relationships across different Fulfilment Centres, understand local requirements and ensure knowledge sharing and consistency across locations.

• Support operational teams: Provide hands-on support during implementation, troubleshooting and post-launch activities where needed.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• Experience in technical project management, engineering, operations, logistics, warehouse design or a comparable field.

• A solid understanding of material flow, operational processes, industrial hardware or warehouse infrastructure.

• Proven ability to independently manage projects, coordinate different stakeholders and drive implementation from concept to completion.

• Experience working with suppliers, contractors or external service providers.

• Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into practical solutions.

• A hands-on, pragmatic mindset and the confidence to take ownership and make things happen in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Willingness to travel internationally for up to 50% of your working time. Regular on-site presence at our European Fulfilment Centres is an essential part of the role.
